preconditions: Use a clean dedicated iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator with the same iOS runtime as the baseline.
No contact named MCP Contact Benchmark exists. Dismiss only the first-run prompts dismissed by the pinned baseline before timing.

checkpoints.goal: A single new contact form is open with the requested first name, last name, and organization entered.

assertions.claim: The new contact form shows first name MCP.
The new contact form shows last name Contact Benchmark.
The new contact form shows organization MobileBuildMCP Benchmark, allowing case differences.

checkpoints.goal: The same new contact form has the requested phone number entered.

assertions.claim: The new contact form shows phone digits 5550104242, allowing display punctuation or grouping differences.

checkpoints.goal: The same new contact form has the requested email address entered.

assertions.claim: The new contact form shows email mcp.contact.benchmark@example.com.

checkpoints.goal: The contact has been saved and its read-only card visibly shows the requested identity and organization.

assertions.claim: The saved contact card, not its edit form, is visible.
The saved card shows MCP Contact Benchmark.
The saved card shows the words MobileBuildMCP Benchmark, allowing case differences.

checkpoints.goal: The same saved contact card visibly shows its phone and email details without entering edit mode.

assertions.claim: The saved card shows phone digits 5550104242, allowing display punctuation or grouping differences.
